name: pager
description: Plays a sound when Claude finishes, needs you or hits an error.

minDuration.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
minDuration.description: Skip the done sound for turns shorter than this. Errors and needs-you always page.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: No sound or phone push in this local time window, e.g. 22:00-07:00 (it may wrap midnight). Empty means off.

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy.sh topic (optional)
ntfyTopic.description: Also send each alert to https://ntfy.sh/<topic> as one HTTPS POST with a fixed title and short text, never conversation content. Empty means off.
